title: TensorDex: A Compact, Tensor-Centric Storage System for Modern AI Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.17104v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern model hubs store hundreds of petabytes of large language models (LLMs), with fine-tuned variants dominating the storage footprint. These variants contain substantial cross-model redundancy that delta compression can exploit by storing only the difference between a target and a reference model. However, compression effectiveness depends critically on choosing a similar reference. At model-hub scale, this is challenging because model lineage metadata is often missing or unreliable, and different tensors within the same model may be most similar to tensors from different models. Consequently, model-level pairing leaves substantial redundancy unexploited.   We present TensorDex, a lossless, tensor-centric storage system that performs delta compression at tensor granularity. TensorDex decomposes models into tensors, uses compact bit-level fingerprints to predict tensor-pair compressibility, and incrementally organizes tensors

translated_title: TensorDex：一种面向现代AI模型的紧凑型、以张量为中心的存储系统
translated_abstract: 现代模型托管平台存储着数百PB规模的大型语言模型（LLM），其中微调变体占据了存储空间的主要部分。这些变体包含大量跨模型冗余，增量压缩（delta compression）可以通过仅存储目标模型与参考模型之间的差异来利用这种冗余。然而，压缩效果在很大程度上取决于能否选择一个相似的参考模型。在模型托管平台的规模下，这极具挑战性，因为模型谱系元数据通常缺失或不可靠，而且同一模型中的不同张量可能与来自不同模型的张量最为相似。因此，模型级别的配对方式会留下大量未被利用的冗余。我们提出了TensorDex，一个无损的、以张量为中心的存储系统，它在张量粒度上执行增量压缩。TensorDex将模型分解为张量，使用紧凑的位级指纹来预测张量对的可压缩性，并以增量方式组织张量。
tldr: TensorDex是一个无损的、以张量为粒度进行增量压缩的存储系统，通过紧凑的位级指纹预测张量对的可压缩性，有效消除模型托管平台中微调变体之间的跨模型冗余。
en_tdlr: TensorDex is a lossless, tensor-centric storage system that performs delta compression at tensor granularity, using compact bit-level fingerprints to predict tensor-pair compressibility and effectively eliminate cross-model redundancy among fine-tuned LLM variants in model hubs.
